props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Fires exactly once when the hold reaches completion

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the button must be held, in milliseconds. Default 1200

props.name: confirmedLabel
props.description: Label shown after a completed hold. Default "Deleted"

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the button. Default "md"

props.name: resetDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before resetting to idle after confirming; 0 stays confirmed. Default 1500
